title: Blue, black, and green trust in finance, legal, and medical mockups
statement:
Across finance, legal and medical website mockups, blue was perceived as the most trustworthy tested color scheme and black as the least trustworthy, while green was the second-most-trusted choice in the finance and medical contexts. (Twente Research Info)

Options:
- Trust blue: blue (fits: reliable, professional, secure)
- Trust green: green (fits: calm, health-oriented, stable)
- Warm red: red (fits: urgent, energetic, assertive)
- Dark black: black (fits: formal, dramatic, luxury)
appliesWhen: Applies to: fintech, health, legal. Audience: adults, general, b2b buyers.

source.title: Color matters: color as trustworthiness cue in web sites
source.authors: Wouter A. Alberts; Thea van der Geest
